name: jev-model-router
description: Picks the model and the reasoning effort of each SUBAGENT (Agent tool and Workflow agent()) with TypeSafe's Jev, a System One decision model reached through TypeSafe's API or the Vercel AI Gateway. The main conversation is not routed unless switched on. Candidates are haiku, sonnet and opus only. When Jev cannot decide, subagents run on a configurable fallback model and effort and the failure is shown. Everything sent out is secret-redacted first.

typesafeApiKey.title: TypeSafe API key
typesafeApiKey.description: Key for TypeSafe's own API; preferred over the Gateway, since only it reports a calibrated confidence

gatewayApiKey.title: Vercel AI Gateway API key
gatewayApiKey.description: Key for the AI Gateway; with no key at all, subagents run on the fallback model and effort (see fallbackModel)

provider.title: Backend
provider.description: Which backend to use; "auto" picks TypeSafe when its key is set, then the Gateway, otherwise no call is made. "builtin" uses the engine's own classifier (no Jev, no confidence) and must be chosen explicitly

typesafeBaseUrl.title: TypeSafe base URL
typesafeBaseUrl.description: Base URL of TypeSafe's own API; empty uses https://api.typesafe.ai. Must be https (http only for localhost); anything else is ignored

typesafeModel.title: TypeSafe model
typesafeModel.description: Decision model on TypeSafe's own API; empty uses jev-latest

gatewayBaseUrl.title: AI Gateway base URL
gatewayBaseUrl.description: Base URL of the AI Gateway; empty uses https://ai-gateway.vercel.sh/v4/ai. Must be https (http only for localhost); anything else is ignored

gatewayModel.title: AI Gateway model
gatewayModel.description: Decision model on the AI Gateway; empty uses typesafe-ai/jev

fastModel.title: Fast tier
fastModel.description: Model for mechanical, local tasks: haiku, sonnet or opus

deepModel.title: Deep tier
deepModel.description: Model for hard or high-stakes work

minUpgradeConfidence.title: Confidence to spend more
minUpgradeConfidence.description: How sure Jev must be to pick a model or effort ABOVE the fallback (0 to 1); being wrong costs money, so the bar is low

minDowngradeConfidence.title: Confidence to spend less
minDowngradeConfidence.description: How sure Jev must be to pick a model or effort BELOW the fallback (0 to 1); being wrong means too little for the task, so the bar is high

fallbackModel.title: Fallback model
fallbackModel.description: What a subagent runs on when Jev gives no usable decision (error, timeout, no key)

fallbackEffort.title: Fallback effort
fallbackEffort.description: The effort of a subagent when Jev gives no usable decision

routeSubagentModel.title: Route subagent models
routeSubagentModel.description: Pick the model of each subagent at agent.spawn, overriding the model the caller passed

routeSubagentEffort.title: Route subagent effort
routeSubagentEffort.description: Set each subagent's reasoning effort (low, medium, high or xhigh; never max) at its turn.step

routeMainEffort.title: Route the main loop's effort
routeMainEffort.description: Raise or lower the reasoning effort of the main conversation. Off by default: it sends your typed prompts to Jev

routeMainModel.title: Route the main loop's model
routeMainModel.description: Change the model of the main conversation. Off by default: it sends your typed prompts to Jev, and switching models mid-session invalidates the prompt cache

timeoutMs.title: Latency budget (ms)
timeoutMs.description: How long a spawn waits for a decision, 100 to 30000; past it the fallback applies and the failure is shown

maxPromptChars.title: Max prompt characters sent
maxPromptChars.description: The subagent prompt is cut to this many characters (200 to 20000) after redaction, before it is sent

redactSensitive.title: Redact secrets before sending
redactSensitive.description: Replace API keys, tokens, private keys, credentials in URLs, secret assignments and high-entropy blobs with [REDACTED:type] placeholders in everything sent to Jev. Best effort, not a guarantee

redactIps.title: Also redact IP addresses
redactIps.description: IPv4 and IPv6. Off by default

redactPatterns.title: Extra redaction patterns
redactPatterns.description: Your own regular expressions, one per line (or a JSON array of strings). Each match is replaced with [REDACTED:custom]. Invalid or backtracking-prone patterns are skipped and reported

logDecisions.title: Log decisions
logDecisions.description: Write each routing decision to the transcript. Failures are always shown, whatever this says
